name: @polleoai/gryphon-provider-config
description: Provider configuration for Gryphon: model catalogs, pricing tables, dropdown options, per-vendor extra-args filter. Pure data + selection layer (cc-switch lesson). No spawning, no streaming, no UI.
author: POLLEO.AI

scripts.prepack: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('dist/index.js')){console.error('prepack: dist/index.js missing - run npm run prebuild at the repo root first');process.exit(1)}fs.copyFileSync('../../LICENSE','LICENSE')"
